item.title: 5 ways leaders can harness brain chemistry for happier and more productive teams
item.description: Dopamine, serotonin, oxytocin, and endorphins offer a framework for understanding how recognition, gratitude, connection, and fun can strengthen workplace culture. Research links employee happiness with higher productivity. A 2019 study led by Oxford University, for example, found that workers were 13% more productive when they were happier. HR teams have responded with enhanced benefits packages, flexible work options, and well-being resources.
